_what: Which LEGACY SPELLING families the owner has authorised folding onto their catalogue code. A value in this file is still only folded when the phrase mapper decodes it to exactly that one code — the list narrows what may be touched, it never widens what a rule decides.
_why_a_file: The measurement found 14 such groups over 1,491 document lines. The owner authorised ONE of them. An authorisation that lives in a transcript is an authorisation the next session invents the scope of, so it lives here with the words he used.
_the_harm_it_bounds: specials composes computeVariantKey, so folding a spelling onto its code MERGES two stock buckets. That is a stock move, not a tidy-up, and it is refused by the same guard every other spec tool uses (scripts/lib/spec-chain-guard.mjs, docs/bugs/0722 and 0844).
_measured: Production run 34728515268, 2026-09-13, company 1: 200 legacy values on 1,491 document lines; 128 of them group onto 14 catalogue codes; 72 (272 lines) the rules can place on no option and which stay as free text.

_notAuthorised_note: Listed so the next session can see exactly what was NOT covered and does not have to re-measure it. These stay as they are until the owner says otherwise. Do not fold them because the nylon round went well.
_both_codes_in_one_phrase: A legacy value may genuinely ask for TWO things: `HB & DIVAN BOTTOM FULLY COVER` decodes to HB Fully Cover AND Divan Full Cover, and that is not ambiguity - it is what the sentence says. The tool folds such a value into ALL of its codes, but ONLY when every one of them is authorised. If even one is not, the value is left alone and reported: folding it would silently drop the meaning that is out of scope, which is worse than not folding at all. Before the owner authorised HB Fully Cover and Divan Full Cover together on 2026-09-13 these phrases were skipped for exactly that reason.
_answered_2026_09_13: The sofa `Seat Base Fully Cover with no Leg` family was asked about separately, because it shares only the words `Fully Cover` with the bedframe ones and is a different request on a different category. Owner answered 「是的 批」. Keep asking that way: a shared word in a code NAME is not evidence that two families are the same request.
_retired_targets_are_refused: 「那就批完」 did NOT include a RETIRED option, and the tool refuses one anyway. `Separate Backrest Packing` is active=false in scm.special_addons (2 spellings, 2 lines). Folding a live line onto a retired option would put a document on a choice the picker no longer offers - the same rule align-line-specials-to-catalogue states in its own header: "a retired option is not something to move a live line onto". If the owner wants those 2 lines folded, the option has to be re-activated first, which is his decision and not a side effect of a fold. UPDATE 2026-09-14: the owner authorised re-activating it if no active equivalent exists. It is listed as authorised, and the fold tool STILL drops it while it is retired, so it cannot be folded before the re-activation has actually happened.
